question: Can the exact original P43 GRUCell with two factual-only causal heads beat a properly trained conventional GRU, MLP, wrong-action-credit version, and fitted strong conventional action-effect ridge on independently authored unfamiliar nuisance dynamics, with cold recall?

world.query_action: one actual +/-1 action for training, both actions physically evaluated after training for scoring only
world.unfamiliar_mode_switch: for first 25% OOD episodes flip sign of beta AFTER t=4, unseen in fitting; no indicator supplied to learners

models.original: Exact NativeTrainableCausalBelief(sensor_dim=1,width=16,min_facts=2) from pinned PR129; BPTT through eight historical factual observe calls; query prediction only uses actual query action for training
models.conventional_gru: Separate GRUCell with exactly the same four factual analog inputs, recurrent width 16, common query/current-sensor/dt features, single nonfactorized action-conditioned readout; within +/-10% parameter count
models.conventional_mlp: Feedforward MLP with same eight factual inputs and current sensor/dt/query action, width 32/24 and scalar readout; report exact parameter count
models.wrong_credit: Exact original P43 model but roll observed executed-action input positions by one within each factual history, retain all actual outcomes and same current query action; no random confound
models.classical: per-world fitted conventional quadratic-time-plus-action ridge using identical eight history factual transitions; prespecified lambda=0.001; separately timed
models.last_effect: last realized action normalized outcome, no learning

training.competence_plateau: last two validation checkpoint changes relative <=1%; if not, no claim baseline fully converged

metrics.primary: MSE on both evaluator-only physically executed query actions on unfamiliar source; report separately for switched and unswitched modes
additional: optimal action choice both external goals +/-0.35
all training and inference wall costs
metrics.frozen_candidate_positive_gate: original P43 OOD MSE <=0.95*min(fully trained conventional GRU,fully trained MLP, fitted polynomial ridge) AND >=0.03 absolute improvement in action optimal fraction on mode-switch cohort above best trainable conventional GRU, for every seed
metrics.wrong_credit_margin: original P43 OOD MSE <=0.80*wrong-action-history-credit model MSE for each seed
metrics.source_strength: wrong-credit sham should weaken effect learning; require no post-result tune or new seed replacement
metrics.full_scientific_PASS: IMPOSSIBLE for this authored exploratory DEV fixture; separate project-owner source birth and cross-platform original qualification required
